name: @tms/shared
//entry: Points at compiled JS, not src/index.ts.
Raw TypeScript as a package entry works locally because tsx and Vite
compile on the fly. Node cannot. On Vercel the deployed server resolved
@tms/shared to src/index.ts and every request died with
ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND — a failure impossible to reproduce in dev.
Consumers must therefore build shared first; the root `dev`, `build` and
vercel `installCommand` all do. Typechecking is unaffected: server and
